    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Australian Grand Prix'
      AND ra.XCL_066 = 2008
      AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
      AND r.XCL_088 != ''
    ORDER BY (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)
           + CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
    LIMIT 1
)

       (SELECT MAX(ps.XCL_055) FROM pitStops ps WHERE ps.XCL_050 = fld.driver_id) AS longest_pit_stop
FROM fastest_lap_driver fld
JOIN drivers d ON d.XCL_034 = fld.driver_id;
